items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins is also here at the interview.

ctx.x: I'll make a note on here first that we are interviewing Mr. Edgar Joseph. Edgar Joseph. Your address is 1625 St. Philip. And the date is August the 7th, I guess. August 7th. Yeah, the 7th, 1961. That's right. And this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins is also here at the interview. Do you mind giving me your full name again? Do you have any middle names?
No, they call me Joseph. My right name is Edgar Joseph.
